name: Slow-Smoked Sliced Turkey Breast with White Roll
whyItWorks: Carved tender smoked turkey breast provides lean, clean protein without greasy skin or spicy rub. Paired with a soft white dinner roll, it offers a gut-friendly meal in the Boardwalk section.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for carved lean turkey breast without outer heavy spice crust. Enjoy with a plain white roll and avoid spicy barbecue sauce.
